title: Hockey-Stick Domination and Distributional Comparison on Finite Posets
summary: We develop a framework for comparing probability measures on finite posets via hockey-stick domination, an order relation defined through interval-counting test functions. The theory introduces poset integrals, derivatives, power functions and the associated moment functionals, all of which are invariant under poset isomorphisms. We prove that hockey-stick domination admits an exact quantitative characterization: whenever $μ$ is dominated by $ν$ in the hockey-stick order, the corresponding Zolotarev-type distance is equal to one half of the second-order poset moment of $ν-μ$.
